name: Class of Achievers Chatbot & Lead Widget
author: ankurraj01

sections.description:
This plugin embeds a smart AI Chatbot into your WordPress site footer.

Configure messaging buttons, call options, colors, prompts, and lead rules directly in the central dashboard.

Join our Affiliate Program at https://digitalmarketingai.classofachievers.in/affiliate and earn recurring commissions for every purchase made by users you refer.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to retrieve configuration and embed the interactive chatbot widget on your WordPress site.

  1. Chatbot Configuration API: The plugin makes server-side HTTP GET requests to https://digitalmarketingai.classofachievers.in/chatbot/config/{bot_id} in the WP Admin settings page to verify connection status. No visitor data is sent.
  2. Chatbot Widget Script: The plugin embeds a front-end script from https://digitalmarketingai.classofachievers.in/static/chatbot-widget.js on your website pages. When visitors interact with the chatbot, messages, IP addresses, and optional contact details are processed by the service to enable conversational AI features.

Terms of Use & Privacy Policy:
* Privacy Policy: https://digitalmarketingai.classofachievers.in/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the class-of-achievers-chatbot-lead-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or search and install it via WP Admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings -> Class of Achievers Chatbot in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your Bot ID from your dashboard.
  5. Save settings, and your AI assistant is active!
